Spain Train Crash Report Cites Four System Failures

A train crash in Spain, which resulted in the death of a Cambridge University scientist, has been attributed to four system failures, according to a report. A memorial mass was held in a Spanish village for the victims of the incident. The event has prompted reflection on the standards of Indian railways.
